searchText: We are looking on building the UI for consolidation, user-triggered withdrawal and user-triggered exit. Where can we find the related contracts, the ABI and the deployed address on Mekong, devnet5 and the upcoming devnet6? code and addresses can be found here: https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-genesis-generator/blob/master/apps/el-gen/genesis_geth.py#L107 source code here: https://github.com/lightclient/sys-asm/tree/main/src (everything is in ASM) Can you make me a devnet5 and devnet6 millionaire? `0x537e0C85Ca9fD164B2f28cf4992420b53Fe65D02` This is meant to test the UI we are building for these new staking features started from the execution layer (consolidation, withdrawal, exit). sent devnet-5 funds here: https://explorer.pectra-devnet-5.ethpandaops.io/tx/0x5ec5ed564e60e6f0903ddbbfef43061ef5abdf2ee35c6eecd3216f7580b82996 devnet-6 will have to be done manually once its up 🙂 Thanks a lot! I guess it's not worth depositing for a few hundred validators on devnet-5 if devnet-6 is launching soon.
